eras.label: v4.1 (before 2026-10-24)
eras.note: Artificial Analysis recomposed the Intelligence Index (v4.3: AutomationBench-AA joins the index, τ³-Banking is removed) and cut the live comparison set to about 52 models. Scores and measured costs per task before and after this date are not comparable: live models were re-scored 4 to 12 points lower on the new composition, and the new evaluation suite costs more to run.

eras.label: v4.3 (before 2026-10-24)
eras.note: Artificial Analysis recomposed the Intelligence Index (v5.0: FrontierCode 2.0, Terminal-Bench-Science and HLE-Diamond join the index; GDPval-AA, SciCode, AA-LCR and Humanity's Last Exam are removed; CritPt is replaced by CritPt v2) and cut the live comparison set to about 72 models. Scores and measured costs per task before and after this date are not comparable: live models were re-scored a median of 10 points lower on the new composition, and the new evaluation suite costs about twice as much to run.
